errors.evidence: The description claims the trajectory of the VideoLLaMB line is 'visually identical' to the VideoLLaMB-R line. However, the plot shows the pink line (VideoLLaMB) is noticeably higher than the olive-gold line (VideoLLaMB-R) at lower frame counts. For example, at approximately 64 frames, VideoLLaMB is at roughly 35 GB while VideoLLaMB-R is at roughly 21 GB.

The prompt requires the description of each line to include representative data points. The description for the VideoLLaMB line does not provide any numerical values, even though several points are visible on the plot (e.g., it starts around 18 GB and rises to about 35 GB at 64 frames).
